title: ITVX / Portrait billboard variant
slide_intent: Compare how the central brand and offer survive a tighter photographed composition, because viewers need to recognize the same service across different situations.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen continuity between campaign recognition and service use.
demonstration: A portrait-format source image shows a billboard with a different set of talent portraits and a STREAM FREE message beneath ITVX.
practical_value: Compare how the central brand and offer survive a tighter photographed composition.
